opening.argument: The speaker promotes copy trading through a description link while presenting unusually attractive returns: he says copy trading earned him "11 percent probably a week" and directs viewers to get started through the description. The linked material advertises a "$6000 BONUS" for cryptocurrency trading, while on-screen leaderboards display returns exceeding 3,000% and 7,800%, reinforcing the appeal of exceptional gains. These earnings are not verified or shown as typical, and the video does include investment-risk and affiliate-income disclosures. Those qualifications limit the claim, but they do not remove the promotional combination of high-return figures, copy-trading access, and a pathway for viewers to begin.
